name: Glow Up Space ✨
description: Share your skincare routines, makeup tips, and self-care journey!

posts.title: My new skincare routine! 😍
posts.text: I finally found products that don't break me out! The serum is a game changer.

comments.text: Wait, what serum are you using?
Cerave hydrating serum! Highly recommend.
Your skin looks amazing btw!
I need to try this ASAP.

posts.title: Help! Sudden breakout before prom 😭
posts.text: Does anyone have quick fixes? I'm panicking.

comments.text: Pimple patches overnight!!!
Yes!! Mighty Patch works miracles.
Ice it wrapped in a towel.
Don't pop it! It will scar.

posts.title: Has anyone tried the new rare beauty blush?
posts.text: I'm debating between Hope and Joy.

comments.text: Joy is sooo pigmented, be careful!
Ooh good to know, I'll use a tiny dot.
Hope is the perfect natural flush.
I want them all tbh.

posts.title: Affordable hair care recs?
posts.text: My hair is so frizzy lately. What do you guys use?

comments.text: Mielle rosemary oil works wonders.
How often do you use it?
A good leave-in conditioner makes a huge difference.
Try a silk pillowcase! Seriously.

name: Study Vibes 📚
description: Aesthetic study notes, Pomodoro buddies, and test prep tips.

posts.title: Finally finished my history notes! 🖋️
posts.text: It took 3 hours but they look so pretty.

comments.text: What highlighters are those?
Mildliners! They are the best.
This motivates me to study rn.
Your handwriting is literally a font.

posts.title: How to stop procrastinating?
posts.text: I keep scrolling TikTok instead of doing my math homework.

comments.text: Put your phone in another room.
I tried but I need it for music 😭
Use the Forest app!
Set a timer for 10 mins. Usually starting is the hardest part.

posts.title: What's in your backpack? 🎒
posts.text: I'm repacking for the new semester.

comments.text: A million lip balms and zero pencils.
Relatable 😂
iPad, water bottle, and snacks.
Emergency kit! Deodorant, hair ties, pads.

posts.title: Does the Pomodoro technique actually work?
posts.text: 25 mins study, 5 mins break. Thinking of trying it.

comments.text: Yes! But I do 50 mins study / 10 mins break.
I might try that, 25 feels too short.
It works until I take a 5 min break that turns into 5 hours.
Definitely helps with burnout.

name: Safe Space 💖
description: Venting, advice, and mental health check-ins. You are loved here.

posts.title: Feeling really left out lately...
posts.text: My friends made a group chat without me. It hurts.

comments.text: I'm so sorry, that's the worst feeling.
Thank you, it's been a tough week.
You deserve better friends! 🥺
I've been there. Focus on yourself for a bit.

posts.title: How to deal with a toxic friend?
posts.text: She constantly belittles me but we've been friends for years.

comments.text: Distance yourself slowly. You don't owe her your energy.
That's good advice. I'll try distancing.
History doesn't excuse bad behavior.
Talk to her about how you feel first.

posts.title: Anxiety is so bad today 😞
posts.text: Everything feels overwhelming and I can't catch my breath.

comments.text: Try the 5-4-3-2-1 grounding method.
Just tried it, it actually helped a little.
Take slow, deep breaths. You're safe.
Sending you a big virtual hug.

posts.title: Just wanted to say you're all beautiful! 🫶
posts.text: Don't let anyone tell you otherwise. Have a great day!

comments.text: Aww thank you! You too! 💕
I needed this today.
You're the sweetest!
